# Custom Host Integration

While [`@personaai/adapters`](/packages/adapters/v0.1.0/index) provides pre-built wrappers for Express, Next.js, and NestJS, `@personaai/runtime` can be hosted in **any environment** that runs JavaScript.

To mount the runtime on a new web framework (such as Fastify, Hono, Koa, or Cloudflare Workers), you implement a two-way bridge:
1. Translate the incoming HTTP request into a `RuntimeRequest`.
2. Send the runtime's `RuntimeResponse` back to the client.

---

## 1. The Runtime Contracts

### `RuntimeRequest`

```ts
export interface RuntimeRequest {
  method: 'GET' | 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH' | 'DELETE' | 'HEAD';
  path: string;
  headers: Record<string, string | undefined>;
  query: Record<string, string | undefined>;
  body?: unknown;
  /** Populated for single-file uploads (POST /files) */
  file?: RuntimeUploadedFile;
  /** Populated for multi-file uploads (POST /knowledge/:id/documents) */
  files?: RuntimeUploadedFile[];
  /** Initially null — populated automatically by resolveUser */
  userId?: string | null;
}

export interface RuntimeUploadedFile {
  filename: string;
  content: Uint8Array;
  contentType?: string;
}
```

---

### `RuntimeResponse`

A response returned by `runtime.handle(req)` is a discriminated union based on `kind`:

```ts
export type RuntimeResponse =
  | RuntimeBufferedResponse
  | RuntimeStreamResponse
  | RuntimeBinaryResponse;

export interface RuntimeBufferedResponse {
  kind: 'buffered';
  status: number;
  headers: Record<string, string>;
  body: string; // Serialized JSON or plain text
}

export interface RuntimeStreamResponse {
  kind: 'stream';
  status: number;
  headers: Record<string, string>;
  body: AsyncIterable<string>; // SSE frames ('data: ...\n\n')
}

export interface RuntimeBinaryResponse {
  kind: 'binary';
  status: number;
  headers: Record<string, string>;
  body: AsyncIterable<Uint8Array>; // Raw byte chunks (file downloads)
}
```

---

## 2. Fastify Adapter Example

```ts
import Fastify, { FastifyRequest, FastifyReply } from 'fastify';
import multipart from '@fastify/multipart';
import {
  createRuntime,
  Runtime,
  RuntimeMethod,
  RuntimeRequest,
  RuntimeUploadedFile,
} from '@personaai/runtime';

export function toFastifyPlugin(runtime: Runtime) {
  return async (fastify: ReturnType<typeof Fastify>) => {
    await fastify.register(multipart, { limits: { fileSize: 50 * 1024 * 1024 } });

    fastify.all('/*', async (req: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
      // 1. Map headers
      const headers: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(req.headers)) {
        headers[k] = Array.isArray(v) ? v.join(', ') : v;
      }

      // 2. Map query params
      const query = (req.query as Record<string, string | undefined>) ?? {};

      // 3. Handle multipart uploads vs JSON bodies
      let body = req.body;
      let file: RuntimeUploadedFile | undefined;

      if (req.isMultipart()) {
        const parts = req.parts();
        const fields: Record<string, unknown> = {};

        for await (const part of parts) {
          if (part.type === 'file' && part.fieldname === 'file') {
            const buf = await part.toBuffer();
            file = {
              filename: part.filename,
              content: new Uint8Array(buf),
              contentType: part.mimetype,
            };
          } else if (part.type === 'field') {
            fields[part.fieldname] = part.value;
          }
        }
        body = fields;
      }

      // 4. Construct RuntimeRequest
      const runtimeReq: RuntimeRequest = {
        method: req.method.toUpperCase() as RuntimeMethod,
        path: req.url.split('?')[0],
        headers,
        query,
        body,
        file,
        userId: null,
      };

      // 5. Execute runtime handler
      const runtimeRes = await runtime.handle(runtimeReq);

      // 6. Send response
      reply.status(runtimeRes.status).headers(runtimeRes.headers);

      if (runtimeRes.kind === 'buffered') {
        return reply.send(runtimeRes.body);
      }

      // Stream SSE or binary bytes with backpressure
      reply.raw.writeHead(runtimeRes.status, runtimeRes.headers);
      for await (const chunk of runtimeRes.body) {
        const canWrite = reply.raw.write(chunk);
        if (!canWrite) {
          await new Promise<void>((resolve) => reply.raw.once('drain', resolve));
        }
      }
      reply.raw.end();
    });
  };
}
```

## 3. Hono / Web Standards Example (Cloudflare Workers / Deno / Bun)

Hono and modern edge runtimes use the web standard `Request` and `Response` interfaces:

```ts
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import {
  createRuntime,
  Runtime,
  RuntimeMethod,
  RuntimeRequest,
  RuntimeUploadedFile,
} from '@personaai/runtime';

export function createHonoHandler(runtime: Runtime) {
  const app = new Hono();

  app.all('/*', async (c) => {
    const req = c.req;
    const url = new URL(req.url);

    // 1. Extract headers & query
    const headers: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
    req.raw.headers.forEach((v, k) => { headers[k] = v; });

    const query: Record<string, string | undefined> = {};
    url.searchParams.forEach((v, k) => { query[k] = v; });

    // 2. Parse body
    const contentType = headers['content-type'] ?? '';
    let body: unknown;
    let file: RuntimeUploadedFile | undefined;

    if (contentType.includes('multipart/form-data')) {
      const formData = await req.formData();
      const fields: Record<string, unknown> = {};

      for (const [k, v] of formData.entries()) {
        if (v instanceof File && k === 'file') {
          file = {
            filename: v.name,
            content: new Uint8Array(await v.arrayBuffer()),
            contentType: v.type || undefined,
          };
        } else {
          fields[k] = v;
        }
      }
      body = fields;
    } else if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'DELETE') {
      try {
        body = await req.json();
      } catch {
        body = undefined;
      }
    }

    // 3. Dispatch to Runtime
    const runtimeReq: RuntimeRequest = {
      method: req.method.toUpperCase() as RuntimeMethod,
      path: url.pathname,
      headers,
      query,
      body,
      file,
      userId: null,
    };

    const runtimeRes = await runtime.handle(runtimeReq);

    // 4. Return Web Standard Response
    if (runtimeRes.kind === 'buffered') {
      return new Response(runtimeRes.body, {
        status: runtimeRes.status,
        headers: runtimeRes.headers,
      });
    }

    // Convert AsyncIterable to ReadableStream
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    const stream = new ReadableStream({
      async start(controller) {
        try {
          for await (const chunk of runtimeRes.body) {
            const data = typeof chunk === 'string' ? encoder.encode(chunk) : chunk;
            controller.enqueue(data);
          }
          controller.close();
        } catch (err) {
          controller.error(err);
        }
      },
    });

    return new Response(stream, {
      status: runtimeRes.status,
      headers: runtimeRes.headers,
    });
  });

  return app;
}
```

---

## 4. Key Considerations for Custom Adapters

1. **Backpressure (`drain`):** When streaming over Node `http` or Fastify (`kind === 'stream'` or `'binary'`), check the boolean return value of `res.write(chunk)`. If `false`, wait for the `'drain'` event before pushing the next chunk to prevent memory spikes on slow network clients.
2. **Mount Path Stripping:** If mounting the runtime under a subpath (e.g. `/api/v1/agents`), set `mountPath: '/api/v1/agents'` in `createRuntime()` so route matching recognizes relative paths like `/chat` and `/threads`.
3. **Graceful Shutdown:** Ensure your host server's shutdown signals (`SIGTERM`, `SIGINT`) invoke `runtime.close()` to stop background eviction timers.
